<text:style bold="true">Operators</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="12" wrap="none"></image:base64>

The operators combine two closed figures that overlap (rectangles, ellipses,
polygons, closed curves). Select the two figures and press the button. The result is
made of real polygons that can be edited like any other figure.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Intersection</text:style>
Only the part that the two figures share is kept.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly two
objects are selected and the two closed figures overlap.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Union</text:style>
The two figures become one outline.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly two objects are
selected and the two closed figures overlap.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Difference</text:style>
The upper figure is cut out of the lower one.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly two
objects are selected and the two closed figures overlap.
